correctness.rationale: The kernel of L_A,B is Hom_{Fq[t]}(Fq^2_B,Fq^2_A). Primary cyclic modules have intertwiner dimension deg(f)min(a,b) for matching f and zero otherwise. Scalar, nonscalar Jordan, split distinct-root and irreducible-quadratic 2x2 similarity types have respectively q, q, binom(q,2), (q²−q)/2 classes of sizes 1, q²−1, q(q+1), q(q−1). Weighted matching-eigenvalue cases give N1 and N2 as stated; identical scalar pairs yield N4=q and no possible primary-type pair gives dimension 3. All other ordered pairs are nullity zero by complement to q^8. Direct independent linear ranks for all ordered pairs q=2,3 matched vectors (88,72,94,2) and (3618,2016,924,3). The algebraic type exhaustion covers all prime powers; finite fields merely corroborate.

This is not a novel Sylvester criterion but a closed distribution law useful for random linear matrix equations.
